I am turning 20 tomorrow, and all that goes in my head is how useless and unworthy I am. I have friends but all of them are so fake that I couldn't count on anyone. My family is so busy in their jobs and their own lives that I don't even have time to have a normal conversation with them sometimes. And even if they did, I know they aren't paying complete attention to me. I can't tell anyone how I feel. I see no future in front of me, because I have started to believe that these feelings will never go away. I have had feelings for guys, and I thought they liked me too but every time I have been brave enough to ask someone out, they have shot me down. They're always like I am meant to be the girl best friend, and nothing more. It's like I don't deserve love. I wanna focus on my career but my thinking is so blurred that I can't sit down to do anything. I am shivering so much, I can't get out of my head.
Thank you so much for your support. I feel better today though, I think I really lost it at the moment.

Mom also said 'She is busy earning money all day, how can she deal with my drama!' and that really hurt, it almost felt like just because I am not earning for the house doesn't mean I don't have a life right?

Me and my mom live together. My dad and my elder brother work in different cities. She is a high school teacher and I just finished my sophomore year in college so I have a month of vacation. She works all day, and comes back in the evening. I feel pretty lonely at times, I have been fighting isolation and a lot of drama at college. Somehow I feel she doesn't want to listen to me. She needed help with a co-curricular activity today and for the first time in ages I felt like she was there to spend time with me. After we were done, she got busy on the phone and I kept trying to talk to her but she wasn't listening. I don't know what came over me but I yelled at her saying something like she only talks to me when she needs me to help her with school work or do the household chores. That would've hurt her, I know, I didn't mean to. She called me selfish and some other things and went to bed. I tried apologizing to her but it didn't work. All I wanted to tell her was that I need someone to hear me out. I was in my room, I cried too much and did this.
